name: talk_face
description: Turn a voice into a talking face for a 3D character: lip sync, blinks, brows, gaze and head motion from the audio. Writes the face move (shape keys, head, neck; several files for a long voice) and a body move (breath, shoulders) as .glb files for direct_scene's play, and prints the play actions. A body move is written only when the character's skeleton has bones to move. moods sets expressions: {from, to, mood} per line, {at, beat, strength, hold} for a one-shot. Free, local, standalone.

output.description: {face: [{path, name, start, duration}], body: {path, name} or null, words, duration, language, keys, missingKeys, gestures, beats, phrases, known: {moods, beats}, play: {face, body}, notes}. play holds ready direct_scene play actions for each face file and the body.

input.description: The voice: audio or video, any format ffmpeg reads

params.name: words
params.description: transcribe's words JSON for this voice. Left out, the step transcribes it and keeps the words beside the moves (<name>-words.json, returned as words) so a re-run with other moods can pass them back.

params.name: language
params.description: Language code, or auto. Default: the transcript's. en uses a pronouncing dictionary, pt Portuguese rules, any other letter rules.

params.name: model
params.description: The character's model.json (or its folder): its own reach and skeleton. Left out, the reference head and skeleton.

params.name: moods
params.description: Expressions, as a list of {from, to, mood} (a mood per line) and {at, beat, strength?, hold?} (a one-shot). The known names come back in the result.

params.name: expressive
params.description: 0..2 (outside it is clamped): the gesture layer's size (brows, nods, look-aways). 0 turns it off.

params.name: name
params.description: Move name. Default: the voice file's name.

params.name: out
params.description: Output path: its name starts every file written (<name>-face.glb, <name>-body.glb, <name>.json). Optional with _project: saved in the project's assets folder.
